description: This file defines the OnboardingActivity class, which manages the onboarding flow in an Android TV application using Leanback's GuidedStepSupportFragment. It sets up the onboarding UI as the root fragment and provides a static method to create an intent for launching this activity.

classes.name: OnboardingActivity
classes.description: An activity that hosts the onboarding flow using Leanback GuidedStepSupportFragment, appearing on first launch or initiated from Home settings.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity and sets up the root onboarding fragment using GuidedStepSupportFragment if this is the first creation.

methods.name: onKeyDown
methods.description: Handles key events; defers to superclass, with GuidedStep managing navigation.

methods.name: intent
methods.description: Static method to create an Intent for launching the OnboardingActivity.
